title: Structural basis of ligand recognition and gating in mosquito IRs
title_zh: 蚊子离子受体的配体识别与通道开放的结构基础
abstract: Ionotropic receptors (IRs) are essential for insect olfaction, enabling the detection of carboxylic acids, amines, moisture, and temperature cues that mediate critical behaviors, including mosquito host-seeking 1,2. However, the structural mechanisms underlying ligand specificity and channel activation in these receptors remain unclear. Here, we report cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures and functional validation of the IR8a-IR75k complex from the malaria mosquito Anopheles stephensi, a carboxylic acid detector, captured in four states: the ligand-free full-length closed form (apo state), the ligand induced full-length open state, and the nonanoic acid (NA)- and octanoic acid (OA)-bound extracellular domains. These structures reveal a dynamic ligand-binding pocket in IR75k, in which specificity is determined by alkyl chain length and carboxylate geometry. Ligand binding triggers closure of IR75k’s bilobed ligand binding domain (LBD), and this conformational change propagates through conserved mechanical linkers to the transmembrane domain (TMD), functioning as a molecular lever that dilates the pore via outward displacement of transmembrane helices. This gating mechanism was further corroborated by molecular dynamics simulations and electrophysiology. These insights provide an atomic resolution view of IR mediated host detection in mosquitoes and establish a foundation for the rational design of next generation mosquito control strategies targeting host-seeking behavior.
abstract_zh: 离子型受体（IRs）是昆虫嗅觉的关键，能够检测到介于关键行为的羧酸、胺、湿度和温度线索，包括伊蚊寻找宿主 1,2。然而，这些受体中配体特异性和通道激活的结构机制仍不清楚。本研究报告了疟疾伊蚊 Anopheles stephensi 中 IR8a-IR75k 复合物的冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）结构及功能验证，该复合物作为羧酸检测器，呈现四种状态：无配体的全长闭合形式（apo 态），配体诱导的全长开放状态，以及结合非酪酸（NA）和八酪酸（OA）的细胞外域。这些结构揭示了 IR75k 中动态的配体结合口袋，其中特异性由烷基链长度和羧酸几何结构决定。配体结合诱导 IR75k 的双叶配体结合域（LBD）闭合，这种构象变化通过保守的机械连接子传递到跨膜域（TMD），作为一个分子杠杆，通过跨膜螺旋的外位移使孔膜扩大。该开放机制进一步通过分子动力学模拟和电生理验证。这些见解提供了伊蚊宿主检测中 IR 介导机制的原子分辨率视图，并为针对寻找宿主行为的下一代蚊虫防控策略的合理设计奠定了基础。
